_doc: city/run/areas.json: the risk classes of the whole-city run. Each: where (SB ids), what bites, the AI key rule, the render / post switches it relies on, and a 3-6 tile probe (lat, lon of the probe centre; tiles = cols x rows of stride-640 AI tiles around it) run before that area's full run. Keys: v5_dry = FIX-v6 base (BASE_DRY), v8_rail4 = the rail-prompt fix (RAIL4 + VEHG, lr_run9_b8.py). prep_sb.py reads 'key_rules' and 'render_env'; city.py reads 'probes'.
render_env_all: Z=9 SE_APRON=1 TREE_EDGE=1 FOOT_SPLIT=1 LM_CLEAR_KEEP=1 ROOF_CALM=1 WATER_V4=1 WAKE_NOAO=1 LM_SF_CROWN=1 LM_MODELS_OVERRIDE=@SNAP/data/oneoffs_models FAITHFUL=1 FA_FILE=@FA_FILE ROOF_NAIP=1 RN_CROP=@RN_CROP BTEX_REAL=1 BTEX_MODE=paint BTEX_FILE=@SNAP/data/faithful/btex_walls_v2g.json BTEX_ATLAS=@SNAP/data/faithful/btex_atlas_v2.png

render_env_gated.SE_DRAPE=1: slope/apron fix: only if its before/after check passed (street_edge agent); probe P-SLOPE renders both
render_env_gated.WATER_V5=1 V5_K=1.6: only if water v5 is adopted (water2 agent); else WATER_V4 alone

pass_env: MASK_PASS=1 CLASS_PASS=1 GID_PASS=1 (a SEPARATE job: GID_PASS in the beauty job paints every facade its gid colour, block52 05:49)

key_rules.when: surface tram / cable-car / light-rail / rail length in the 1024 tile >= RAIL_M metres (rails_b8.rail_len, OSM, projected with the viewer DEM)
every other AI tile (the '_lot' clause stays dropped, as block52_v7 / b8)

post: quilt stride 640 (quilt_stream.py = tp_quilt_c, streamed by tile row)
compose (class water = render, docks + near-water plants = render)
piers (narrow_piers r90 <= 30 px: the render deck)
colour b (facades, table colours, L cap 8) with per-building stats over the whole building (colour2: fixes the band-line step of post_b7)
tiles z9 webp q90 + pyr_down.py z8..z0

rails.what: cable cars (Powell / Hyde / California), Market St + F line, N-Judah, L-Taraval, K / M (West Portal, 19th Ave), J-Church, T-Third, Caltrain 4th & King + the Mission Bay yard. v5_dry_rail2 painted rails + trolley wires on EVERY street of a rail tile and ballast on wide railed roads (block52_v7 road sweep).
rails.key: v8_rail4 on rail tiles (RAIL_M 30 m, calibrated on block52's rail2 set: check rails_b8.py output at the freeze)
rails.switches: none new; road_fix.py stays NOT wired (v8_rail4 replaces it)

probes.name: Hyde St cable car at Lombard
N-Judah on Judah St / 30th Ave (street-running LRV)

slopes.what: Twin Peaks (bare grass, figure-eight road), Bernal Hill, Potrero Hill, Russian / Nob Hill, Mt Davidson, McLaren: SE_APRON aprons / stoops on steep streets float or step (the engine triangle plane; SE_DRAPE drapes them on 3DEP); the AI reads steep street steps as walls / stairs; bare hill grass as dirt lots.

probes.name: Twin Peaks summit + Christmas Tree Pt Rd
Bernal Heights (Folsom St slope + the hill)

piers.what: Aquatic Park Municipal Pier (curved, ~6 m), Marina small-craft floats, Fort Mason piers, Pier 70 / 80 / 96, Hunters Point docks, Treasure Island marina, Torpedo Wharf: the AI has no room on a narrow deck and invents rubble / houses / trees (Pier 7 in block52_v7).
piers.switches: post step_piers (narrow_piers r90 <= 30 px, water share >= 0.4) + compose docks = render

probes.name: Aquatic Park Municipal Pier + Hyde St Pier ships

parks.what: Golden Gate Park (Stow Lake, Polo Field, Conservatory, bison paddock, windmills), the Presidio forest + Main Post, Lands End, McLaren, Lake Merced, Stern Grove: invented paths / buildings / roofs in big canopy, lawn turned to dirt or a lot, inland lakes (render water v4 on small lakes: shore colour), veg_shore flags (b7 fin.log: many cells).

surf.what: Ocean Beach: WATER_V4 is bay chop (JONSWAP, no breaking surf): the Pacific at the beach reads as a flat bay with no white surf lines; sand / dunes / Great Highway next to class water; Seal Rocks; Fort Funston cliffs. Water px are the render (compose), so the AI cannot fix or break it.
surf.switches: WATER_V4 (V5 if adopted); known gap: no surf model (decision D4: accept for v1 or a surf-foam band later, no look experiment in this run)

probes.name: Ocean Beach at Judah / Great Highway
Cliff House / Sutro Baths ruins / Seal Rocks

industrial.what: Pier 80 cranes + container yard, Islais Creek, Hunters Point shipyard, Bayview warehouses, the Mission Bay / Caltrain yards: huge flat roofs (roof camo, dark membranes), lots read as roofs / roofs as lots, AI adds containers / cars / trucks on empty yards.
industrial.switches: ROOF_CALM=1; post roof_fix; detectors roof->lot, roof_color

south_edge.what: The county line (lat 37.708): Daly City / Brisbane are NOT modelled (empty terrain in the render). Terrain tiles (>= 95 % water + outside SF) stay the render (no AI: it would invent houses on the empty hills); the AI'd city tiles meet the render terrain along a line: a look step (warm AI vs cooler render) and cut buildings at the edge. No airport in the extent (SFO is south of row 31).
south_edge.key: v5_dry on city tiles; terrain tiles = render (TERRAIN_AI=0)
south_edge.switches: none; decision D3: render-only terrain (default) vs AI on terrain

probes.name: Geneva Ave / Crocker-Amazon at the county line

landmarks.what: Golden Gate Bridge + Fort Point, Palace of Fine Arts, City Hall dome, St Mary's Cathedral (C9 flat facade known), Painted Ladies, Sutro Tower (thin lattice: the AI may erase or thicken it), Legion of Honor, Conservatory, de Young tower, Cal Academy living roof, Mission Dolores, Chase Center, Alcatraz, Treasure Island Building 1 + hangars, the Bay Bridge + YBI tunnel, the windmills, Lombard crooked street.
landmarks.switches: LM_CLEAR_KEEP=1, LM_SF_CROWN=1, LM_MODELS_OVERRIDE (block52 one-off models: c_sspp, t_555cal) city-wide

probes.name: Golden Gate Bridge south tower + Fort Point

sb_seams.what: Super-block edges: tiles on both sides come from different windows. The tile registry (a tile is generated once, first SB wins) + the L8 registry (a window's shared L8 canvas is pre-filled from its neighbours' L8, sl8v_city.py) make both sides use the same tiles and the same L8 context.

probes.name: b8 west edge (x 102400) at Broadway: 3 x 2 tiles of C3R1 next to b8's tiles, L8 pre-filled from b8's l8_b8.jpg
